_about: Open roles at Spokane-area companies in the directory, each one read off the employer's own board or ATS feed on 2026-10-02 and carrying the URL it came from. title, pay and posted date are the posting's own; pay_posted is the range exactly as the employer wrote it.
_classification: discipline, level and workplace are the posting mapped onto this board's closed vocabularies, not facts the employer stated in those words. Where the posting gave no workplace at all the role is left out rather than guessed.
_expiry: db/load-jobs.ts expires every row 90 days after the load, or on closes_at where the employer published a closing date, whichever is sooner.
_excluded: Seen and left out: IntelliTect 'Product Sales Manager – Case Amplify' and Key Tronic 'Senior Program Manager' (no pay range on the employer's page; the schema requires one). Corporate Tools' Spokane roles (posted as 'Up to $X' with no floor). Itron 'Senior Product Manager' (Austin-primary, no workplace stated). OpenEye 'Technical Product Manager' (no workplace stated). Spiceology 'FSQA Coordinator' (food safety, not a tech role). ENGIE Impact, Gravity Jack and Treasury4 had no verifiable Spokane postings on their own sites.
